description:
What a wonderful evening filled with laughter, entertainment, masti and fellowship! 🎉 Thank you to all our 79 members including 3 new prospective members for joining in the fun and making our Diwali celebration truly memorable.

🌟 A few special highlights of the evening (a litle long but heartfelt):

The evening began on a patriotic note with the National Anthem, followed by a warm welcome address including update on the club activities by our President, Rtn. Nikhil Madgavkar.

A heartfelt thank you to Rtn. Amit Sheth for his constant help and support throughout the event, including assistance with booking the venue and ensuring everything went smoothly. Your support and commitment are truly appreciated.

A special thank you to Rtn Tejal Sheth, Rtn Krutee Ranpara, Sonali Thakrar, Davina Bali and Rtn Smita Madgavkar for the beautiful Diwali decorations, colourful Rangoli, glowing diyas and festive touches that transformed the venue and added so much sparkle to our Diwali Dhamaka.
